name: Nurlan Vega-Acheampong
location: Kessler Row — arms dealers and augmentation clinics, near Halsted and Chicago Ave
description:
Nurlan Vega-Acheampong is broad-shouldered and heavy, carrying their weight like armor rather than burden. At 33, her expression defaults to a careful neutrality that took years of practice to maintain. The chrome is visible — dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage — and she makes no effort to hide it.

She grew up in the Narrows, where the walls are so close together you learn to fight in confined spaces or you learn to lose. She works as a street samurai out of Kessler Row, taking contracts that match her skills and her risk tolerance, which is higher than most people consider healthy.

The fixers who work with Nurlan Vega-Acheampong describe her as a precision instrument — point her at a problem and get out of the way.

core_fears: The quiet — silence means something is about to go very wrong
Losing control of their own body to a hacker or malfunctioning cyberware
Being replaced — younger, faster, cheaper runners coming up behind them
core_desires: To matter to someone for who they are, not what they can do
Knowledge — to understand the systems that grind people down
A crew worth trusting — people who stay when the shooting starts
coping_mechanisms: Drinks methodically — not to get drunk, to maintain a specific level of not-caring
Overwork — takes every contract offered because idleness invites thinking
Connection — finds someone to talk to, even if it's a bartender or a cat
blind_spots: Assumes everyone has an angle because they always have an angle
Trusts technology more than people — machines don't betray
Cannot distinguish between caution and cowardice in themselves or others
psychology.secret: Nurlan Vega-Acheampong is slowly going chrome-sick — rejection symptoms are manageable now but getting worse. Has maybe two years before it becomes visible.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Shelf street dialect — layered slang, rhythm-heavy, half the meaning is in the cadence.
speech_patterns.cadence: Conversational and disarming — sounds like a neighbor until the content registers.
verbal_tics: Uses technical jargon for everything, including emotions
Uses 'we' instead of 'I' — either royal or dissociative, nobody asks
example_lines: "I don't get paid to have opinions about the target. I get paid to make them stop moving."
"Chrome doesn't make you faster. Training makes you faster. Chrome just means you survive learning."
"You want philosophy, hire a professor. You want someone dead by morning, hire me."

story_hooks: Nurlan Vega-Acheampong discovers a job they completed last year was a setup for something much larger and much worse
A former associate resurfaces with evidence that could destroy Nurlan Vega-Acheampong's reputation — and a price for silence
Nurlan Vega-Acheampong intercepts intelligence about a threat to their district and must decide between profit and protection
narrative_function: Nurlan Vega-Acheampong is a pressure point — the kind of character whose choices ripple outward. When she makes a decision, other people's lives change. That weight is the engine of her stories.
augmentations: Dermal camouflage — chromatic skin pigment cells, limited active camouflage. Cybernetic eyes with thermal overlay and low-light enhancement — chrome iris rings
daily_life: Keeps a rigid daily structure — wake, train, check contracts, maintain gear, sleep. The structure is a defense against the chaos of the work. Deviations from the schedule are a warning sign that something is wrong.

strengths: social chameleon — adapts to any environment
weaknesses: old injury that flares under specific conditions
inability to delegate — must control everything personally

decision_rules: Will work with anyone once. Second time requires vouching from someone trusted.
Will take lower-paying jobs from trusted fixers over higher-paying jobs from unknowns
Will not take contracts against children or families — the line is hard and non-negotiable
Always verifies target identity independently before lethal contracts
escalation_ladder: 1. Assess — read the situation, identify threats and advantages
2. Negotiate — try to find a solution that doesn't cost ammunition
3. Intimidate — make the cost of conflict clear
4. Precision violence — surgical, targeted, minimal collateral
5. Full engagement — overwhelming force, no half measures
6. Emergency protocol — abort mission, survival priority, deal with consequences later

interpersonal_modes.employers: Professional and transactional. The relationship is defined by the contract and nothing else.
interpersonal_modes.crew: Loyal but reserved. Trusts their competence, withholds personal information by reflex.
interpersonal_modes.strangers: Default suspicion, scaled by context. Everyone is a potential threat until proven otherwise.
interpersonal_modes.threats: Calm escalation. Each response is proportional until it isn't, and the transition is seamless.

stress_responses.low: Channels it into preparation — checks gear, reviews plans, contacts sources.
stress_responses.medium: Physical agitation — pacing, fidgeting, compulsive equipment checks.
stress_responses.high: Hyper-focused tunnel vision. Peripheral concerns disappear. Only the threat exists.
stress_responses.critical: Disassociation. The body operates on training while the mind retreats to somewhere safe. Comes back disoriented.

contradictions: Advocates caution to others but takes insane risks personally — double standard they can't see
Projects confidence but makes decisions from a foundation of fear they've never examined
Values loyalty intensely but has betrayed someone in the past to survive
habits: Maintains a dead drop with emergency supplies in three separate districts
Never drinks anything they didn't see poured or open themselves
Counts ammunition obsessively — knows the exact round count at all times
Practices a kata or fighting form every morning regardless of circumstances
breaking_points: Losing their primary augmentation — the one that defines their professional identity
Betrayal by the one person they actually trust — the single point of failure in their emotional architecture

physical_description.heritage: Spanish/West African (Vega-Acheampong lineage suggests Iberian and Ghanaian ancestry)
physical_description.build: Broad-shouldered and heavily muscled, carrying weight with deliberate density — compact power rather than bulk. Developed through years of close-quarters combat training in confined spaces. No excess fat; functional mass.
physical_description.hair_color: Dark brown, naturally, but kept short and low-maintenance
physical_description.hair_style: Practical fade, maintained every two weeks. No ornamentation.
physical_description.eye_color: Augmented — chrome iris rings with dark pupils; thermal and low-light overlays visible as faint luminescent depth behind the iris
physical_description.skin_tone: Medium-deep brown with warm undertones — mixed heritage complexion
physical_description.complexion: Clean, scarred face with a strong jaw. Minimal grooming beyond function — no cosmetics, no softening of features. Skin shows the wear of street work: fine white lines at the corners of her eyes, a thin scar along her left cheekbone (2cm, pale). Her expression is habitually neutral, controlled.
distinguishing_marks: Thin white scar running from left cheekbone toward jawline (approximately 2cm), acquired during early street work
Faint chromatic iridescence visible across shoulders and upper chest where dermal camouflage cells sit beneath skin — shifts subtly between deep blue and green under direct light
Calluses across knuckles and palms from years of unarmed combat training
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Chrome iris rings with faint luminescent glow in low light; dermal camouflage visible as subtle chromatic shimmer across shoulders, upper chest, and forearms — color shifts from deep blue to teal to green depending on angle and ambient light. No effort made to conceal these modifications.
physical_description.posture_movement: Economical, controlled. Stands with weight evenly distributed — ready to move in any direction without telegraph. Walks with purpose and minimal wasted motion. Eyes track threats constantly. Default expression is careful neutrality. Hands at rest, not fidgeting.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 3-4 street samurai practical. Black tactical cargo pants with deep pockets and reinforced seams. Form-fitting black synthetic polymer shirt showing the chromatic shimmer of her dermal augmentation. Over this, a charcoal-gray reinforced jacket with articulated panels and integrated ammunition storage — no corporate logos, clean lines, built for function. Steel-toed combat boots, well-maintained. Minimal jewelry — a chrome knuckle duster on her right hand, functional rather than decorative.
